subject: Re: Benchmark methodology & SLO qualification (latency/throughput/concurrency)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@edgefin.com>, Bob Singh <bob@edgefin.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Benchmark methodology & SLO qualification (latency/throughput/concurrency)

Thanks again for the time today - great discussion. Per our call, I wanted to capture the key SLO/benchmark questions and proposed next steps so we can scope the benchmark run and get you reproducible numbers: 

Summary of customer targets (from today's call):
- Latency SLO: 95th pct latency goal of ~150ms for short-response streaming (<=256 tokens).
- Throughput target: sustained 200 reqs/minute during peak (30 minute windows).
- Concurrency: support 40 concurrent streaming sessions with tail latency under SLO.
- Determinism / reproducibility: need harness that runs 3 repeated trials and documents system config (model version, quantization, GPU type).
- Streaming behavior: must support chunked token streaming with partial-delivery latencies measured.

Questions / clarifications (action items for EdgeFin):
1) Can you share a representative prompt set (10-20 prompts) that captures your short/med/long response distribution?
2) Are there strict output-quality checkpoints (e.g., exact match, human-eval pass rate) we should include?
3) Any networking constraints (VPC/IP allowlist) we should know about for benchmark agents?

Next steps (Redwood):
- I attached a first-cut benchmark harness (redwood_benchmark_harness_v1.zip) and an SLO worksheet (slo_requirements.xlsx). Please treat the harness as a reproducible runner - it emits CSVs with per-token latencies, 50/95/99 pct, and concurrency traces.
- If you can send the prompt set + sample payloads by Tuesday, we'll schedule a dedicated benchmark run the week of 6/29.
- Rishi will scope the infra needed (GPU class, concurrency knobs).

If that all looks right, we can lock in a run time. Thanks - looking forward to getting you concrete numbers.


Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@edgefin.com>

Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Benchmark methodology & SLO qualification (latency/throughput/concurrency)

Thanks Marissa - helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side after reviewing internally:

1) Latency: 150ms 95th for streaming is our aspirational target for the interactive product. For batch generation (non-streaming) we can accept higher tail latencies (up to 400ms 95th). Please ensure the harness reports streaming vs non-streaming buckets.
2) Throughput/Concurrency: the 200 reqs/minute is a sustained peak - during flash-sales we can spike to 400 reqs/min for short bursts. Concurrency target of 40 is correct; if we can demonstrate graceful degradation beyond that, even better.
3) Prompt set: attaching a short set (10 prompts) and an anonymized sample payload. The prompts skew short (avg 48 tokens) with occasional long-doc summarization (>=1024 tokens) - we recognize the long-case is out-of-scope for the 150ms goal.

We do have a VPC allowlist - I'll share the IP range offline with Neha. Also: for reproducibility, please include exact model binary hash / config in the run output.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. If you can run an initial baseline with default quantization + a second run with int8 quant, that would be ideal.

Quick internal note before we kick off the run:
- For the 150ms 95th streaming target we should plan to test on our A100s and on one mid-range GPU (40GB Ampere-class) to show delta.
- Harness: run 3 trials for each config (default fp16, int8 quant) and collect per-token tail percentiles and streaming chunk latency.
- Networking: use separate NICs and pin benchmark agents to avoid noisy-neighbor interference.
- Scheduling: I can free up infra the week of 6/29 - propose Tue 6/30 10:00 PT for a 2-hour baseline run.

Marissa - can you confirm time with EdgeFin and get the prompt set + sample payloads? I'll draft the run plan and the csv schema we expect.

Rishi
